**Chinese name:** 黑芝麻智能科技有限公司 (Hēizhīma Zhìnéng Kējì Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded July 2016, also Hong Kong Stock Exchange-listed alongside Horizon Robotics, its closest domestic competitor in automotive AI chips. H1 2026 revenue reached ¥458 million (+81.3% YoY, its fourth consecutive year of high YoY growth) with gross margin nearly doubling to 49.5% (gross profit +261.9% YoY) and cumulative chip shipments passing 6 million units — but net loss still widened slightly to ¥770 million, underscoring that revenue growth has not yet translated into profitability.
:::

## What does this firm design?

AI chips for self-driving cars and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), including image processing and perception algorithms.
